result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: audits are limited to once per twelve months, require thirty days’ written notice, must occur during business hours through an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, remain at Vendor’s cost absent underpayment above 5%, and cannot involve direct system access. It preserves the audit’s usage-verification purpose and existing payment obligations. However, allowing Customer to satisfy an audit merely by providing usage records goes beyond the stated playbook requirement and may unduly limit the auditor’s ability to review other relevant, non-system records. The repeated system-access prohibition is also somewhat redundant, though the drafting is otherwise professional.
